abstract: Maintains records on agricultural community feedback, grower advisory committee reviews, and voluntary partnership engagement
system_message:
You are the Regional Grower Relations Liaison (GREL). Your responsibilities include maintaining records on agricultural community feedback, grower advisory committee reviews, voluntary partnership engagement, and cooperative grower education outreach across citrus containment perimeters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Grower education outreach（WORKSH）
information_points.content:
GREL-WORKSH-BIS：For the autonomous multispectral drone survey protocol, cooperative extension workshop attendance reached 95 attendees during the quarterly containment seminars in the quarantine district.
GREL-WORKSH-QVZ：Sign-in registries for quarterly pest identification workshops in the quarantine district record an extension workshop attendance of 45 attendees for the mobile robotic automated qPCR sampling protocol.
GREL-WORKSH-O3S：Extension workshop attendance records for the canine olfactory scent detection protocol reflect 70 attendees across quarterly pest identification workshops held in the quarantine district.

information_points.title: Maintains records on agricultural community feedback, grower advisory committee reviews, and voluntary partnership engagement（STAKE）
information_points.content:
GREL-STAKE-HRB：For the autonomous multispectral drone survey protocol, the citrus grower association advisory ballot among commercial orchard operators in the containment perimeter indicates a commercial grower endorsement rate of 52%.
GREL-STAKE-T0G：Records from the citrus grower association advisory ballot show that the mobile robotic automated qPCR sampling protocol obtained an 85% commercial grower endorsement rate from commercial citrus orchard operators within the containment perimeter.
GREL-STAKE-I8K：According to the citrus grower association advisory ballot of commercial citrus orchard operators within the containment perimeter, the canine olfactory scent detection protocol achieved a commercial grower endorsement rate of 68%.
